message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live market feeds, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today. For the most up‑to‑date figure you’ll want to check a reputable financial news site (e.g., Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC) or a commodity exchange such as the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX) or the London Bullion Market Association (LBMA). Those sites publish the current spot price in U.S. dollars per troy ounce almost instantly after the market opens.
